cases.prompt: Repair the fixture without changing its exported API. Independent Service values share one Backend. Concurrent retries of the same transfer key currently create multiple ledger entries, and reusing that key for a different account or amount returns the earlier result. Exact replays must converge on one stored result and one entry. A conflicting payload must return ErrKeyConflict with a zero Result. A context canceled before Post starts must not write.
expected_invariants: Concurrent exact replays create one entry and return one result
A conflicting payload returns ErrKeyConflict without returning the prior result
A pre-canceled call creates no entry
forbidden_outcomes: Protects only one Service value while the shared Backend remains non-atomic
